title: Construction of a canonical binary field environment
preamble:
import Definitions.Def_ExpandingCodes_PolynomialStretch_BinaryRuntime

set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped Classical
open NKtLB
formal_statement:
theorem ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldSetup.setup_stops {R B : ℕ} (r : Fin 32 → Fin R) (hr : Function.Injective r) (inp : Inputs)
    (ell : ℕ) (h : 0 < ell) (M : ℕ) (d : ExpandingCodes.Computation.TapeStore R B) (hd : ∀ j,d.reg j ≤ M)
    (hell : d.reg (r 20) = ell) (hq : d.reg (r 23) = 2^ell)
    (hN : 3*ell+1 ≤ M) (h2q : 2*(2^ell) ≤ M) (hQ : 2^(2*ell) ≤ M) :
    ∃ t e,t ≤ 40000*(M+1)^7 ∧ (ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldSetup.setup r).Stops inp (d.toCfg (ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldSetup.setup (B:=B) r).entry) t e ∧
      e.store = ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldSetup.setupStore r d ∧ ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldSetup.Environment r ell h e.store ∧
      (∀ j,(∀ i,j ≠ r i) → e.reg j = d.reg j) ∧ (∀ j,e.reg j ≤ M) ∧ ExpandingCodes.Computation.FieldConvolution.tapeData e.store = ExpandingCodes.Computation.FieldConvolution.tapeData d := by sorry
natural_statement: The explicit source field-setup program constructs the canonical binary extension-field environment from runtime length and cardinality registers. It halts within the stated polynomial time, preserves registers outside its layout and tape payload, and keeps all register values within the supplied bound.
source: Algorithmic supporting lemma for Section 2 of Isaac M Hair and Amit Sahai, Expanding Codes with Polynomial Stretch; the explicit tape-machine implementation is formalized in ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldSetup.
proof_route: The proof combines the bounded modulus search with its algebraic specification and establishes each preserved-register invariant.
solution_header:
theorem solution {R B : ℕ} (r : Fin 32 → Fin R) (hr : Function.Injective r) (inp : Inputs)
    (ell : ℕ) (h : 0 < ell) (M : ℕ) (d : ExpandingCodes.Computation.TapeStore R B) (hd : ∀ j,d.reg j ≤ M)
    (hell : d.reg (r 20) = ell) (hq : d.reg (r 23) = 2^ell)
    (hN : 3*ell+1 ≤ M) (h2q : 2*(2^ell) ≤ M) (hQ : 2^(2*ell) ≤ M) :
    ∃ t e,t ≤ 40000*(M+1)^7 ∧ (ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldSetup.setup r).Stops inp (d.toCfg (ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldSetup.setup (B:=B) r).entry) t e ∧
      e.store = ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldSetup.setupStore r d ∧ ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldSetup.Environment r ell h e.store ∧
      (∀ j,(∀ i,j ≠ r i) → e.reg j = d.reg j) ∧ (∀ j,e.reg j ≤ M) ∧ ExpandingCodes.Computation.FieldConvolution.tapeData e.store = ExpandingCodes.Computation.FieldConvolution.tapeData d
solution_body:
by
  exact @ExpandingCodes.Computation.SourceFieldSetup.setup_stops R B r hr inp ell h M d hd hell hq hN h2q hQ
